title: Neon Breakout
description: Smash glowing bricks, chase combos, and clear every level before your lives run out.

title: Neon Snake
description: Eat, grow and speed up. Grab the bonus stars before they fade, and don't bite your own tail.

title: Neon Stack
description: Rotate, slide and drop falling blocks to clear lines. Hold a piece for later and chain combos as the speed climbs.
controls: Arrows + X/Z / drag and tap / gamepad

title: Astro Blaster
description: Thrust, drift and blast through waves of splitting space rocks. Watch out for the saucer from wave 3.

title: Neon Runner
description: Sprint through a synthwave city. Jump, double jump and slide past barriers, drones and gaps as the pace keeps climbing.

title: Star Siege
description: Hold the line against marching alien waves. Duck behind shields, snipe the mothership, and team up with a friend in co-op.

title: Neon Hop
description: Hop across four lanes of traffic and a river of drifting logs and diving turtles to fill all five docks before the timer runs out.

title: Neon Pong
description: The original paddle duel with spin and speed-ups. Take on the CPU or a friend, first to 7.

title: Neon Maze
description: Clear the maze while four chasers with their own tactics close in. Grab a power cell and turn the hunt around.

title: Neon Pinball
description: A glowing table of bumpers, slingshots, drop targets and rollover lanes. Build the multiplier to x5 across three balls.

title: Danfo Dash
description: Drive a yellow Lagos danfo through rush-hour traffic. Pick up passengers and naira, dodge okada, keke, trucks and potholes.
